reviewMethod.primaryEvidence: Authoritative 2025 Oregon Revised Statutes chapter HTML
procedure: Read the published chapter heading and 2025 edition marker.
Transcribed operative section numbers and catchlines from the chapter's published contents list.
Audited the full chapter body for section stubs omitted from the contents list.
Added body-only repealed stubs 12.030, 12.133 and 12.260 and classified them from their printed repeal credits.
Checked the body through the final section 12.480 for additional repealed or renumbered section anchors; no renumbered stubs were printed.
